name: web-cake-shop-project-slide-on-chocolate-with-flower-sticker
title: Cake shop UI/UX slide with goal and solution text beside a laptop and outline flower sticker
whatItIs: A deep chocolate slide with small header labels, a large cream 'cake shop' title, two paragraphs with bold Goal and Solution lead-ins, a laptop showing the cobalt cake site, a cream-outlined flower sticker and a script 'project 2' outline sticker.
whatItMeans: Warm and confident; the dark brown frame makes the cobalt screen glow.
techniques: Use cream on chocolate for all text.
Add outline stickers overlapping the device corners.
Lead each paragraph with a bold label.
Let the bright screen be the only saturated element.
bestFor: Portfolio decks with a consistent template

vocabulary.definition: A two-paragraph structure describing intent and answer.
A shape or script with a thick contrasting border.
A dark slide that makes a bright screen pop.
Repeating a slide layout across projects.
